## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) BELOW TREND (↓ falling) provide independent confirmation alongside Cyclical vs Defensive (0.7663, 1W: +2.81% ↑ rising) ABOVE TREND.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Stocks vs Bonds SPY/TLT (SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND / TLT (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND) ↑ rising confirms risk appetite; VXX (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) ↓ falling shows fear easing; Credit Spread (Level: 0.7322 | 1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.26%) ↑ rising is a watch item despite HYG (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Dollar (Level: 27.4400 | 1W: -1.40% ↓ falling) BELOW TREND and Yield Curve (Level: 1.0495 | 1W: -0.34% → flat) BELOW TREND point to modest easing in financial conditions while duration preference (0.9078 → flat) remains muted.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Cyclicals and Materials leading: XLF (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND and XLB (1W: +3.07% | 1M: +4.72%) ABOVE TREND; Tech also strong with XLK (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND — style: Growth/Momentum leading confirmed by breadth.

5. US vs Global?  
US strong: SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND; EM leadership: EEM (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: +1.94% | 1M: -0.41%) RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Risk-on spec flows evident: IBIT (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +3.98% | 1M: +3.53%) ABOVE TREND, though the Speculation Index (1W: -2.33% ↓ falling) BELOW TREND flags some pullback in excess risk.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Copper recovering: CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY; precious metals in short-term bounce with GLD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +5.00% | 1M: -11.33%) RECOVERY — reflation signals mixed but present.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy divergence: XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%) CORRECTION show volatile pullback inside a longer-term uptrend, while UNG (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) BELOW TREND signals weakness in nat gas.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: SPY, XLK, XLF all ABOVE TREND (SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%), XLK (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%), XLF (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +5.51%)) supporting the RISK-ON call. DIVERGENCE: Energy/commodities (USO/UGA/BNO/XLE) show 1W vs 1M mismatches → Minor divergence.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals/materials exposure given breadth and momentum — XLF (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND and XLB (1W: +3.07% | 1M: +4.72%) ABOVE TREND showing strength; reduce exposure to energy beta like XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) BELOW TREND; monitor bonds TLT (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: SOXX (1W: +13.84% | 1M: +13.08%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +3.07% | 1M: +4.72%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION, UNG (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper/industrial complex CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY.  
BEARISH: Oil volatility (USO 1W: -9.50% | 1M: +15.52% CORRECTION; BNO (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%) CORRECTION) and nat gas UNG BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX/VIX ~30 (VXX / VIX: VXX (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) ↓ falling) — complacency threshold; Credit Spread ~0.7322 (1W: +0.10% ↑ rising) — watch widening; SPY/TLT 7.86 (1W: +3.31% ↑ rising) — risk-on signal; XLK/XLF 2.8091 (1W: +2.44% ↑ rising) — growth vs value pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, SPY (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) BELOW TREND confirm. Cyclicals and materials (XLF, XLB) showing strength while energy (XLE) and natural gas (UNG) are notable divergences to monitor.
